title: Chronos Policy: Learning Robot Policies on Physical Time
title_zh: Chronos 策略：在物理时间上学习机器人策略

paragraphs.en: Chronos策略通过将观察捕获时间和动作执行时间显性化，提高了机器人在动态任务中的性能。 Robot policies often convert sensing and control into fixed-rate observation-action sequences, leaving physical time implicit in sequence position. This assumption breaks when observation rates or delays vary, or when inference latency changes. We introduce Chronos Policy, which makes physical time explicit by conditioning on observation capture times and desired action execution times. We study two ways to incorporate time into a diffusion transformer: adding timestamp embeddings to token features, or encoding physical time in positional encoding through time-aware rotary positional encodings (time-aware RoPE). We find that time-aware RoPE is more robust, allowing attention to depend directly on physical time while keeping token content unchanged. During training, we temporally randomize which observations are sampled and when the action chunk begins, exposing the policy to a wider range of sensing and execution schedules that may occur during deployments. This also enables learning from asynchronous, multi-rate data without forcing all measurements onto a fixed temporal grid. Across simulation and real-world experiments, Chronos Policy improves performance on dynamic tasks, where observation-to-action timing is critical, and on multisensory tasks, where the relative timing between observations matters. On standard quasi-static tasks, it preserves nominal performance while improving robustness to changes in sensing and inference timing.
paragraphs.zh: Chronos策略通过将观察捕获时间和动作执行时间显性化，提高了机器人在动态任务中的性能。机器人策略通常将感知和控制转化为固定速率的观察-动作序列，使得物理时间在序列位置中保持隐式。 当观察频率或延迟发生变化，或者推理延迟改变时，这一假设便不再成立。 我们提出了Chronos策略，它通过以观察捕获时间和期望的动作执行时间为条件，使物理时间变得显性。 我们研究了将时间融入扩散变换器的两种方法：在令牌特征中添加时间戳嵌入，或通过时间感知旋转位置编码（time-aware RoPE）在位置编码中编码物理时间。 我们发现时间感知RoPE更具鲁棒性，它允许注意力直接依赖于物理时间，同时保持令牌内容不变。 在训练过程中，我们对哪些观察被采样以及动作块何时开始进行时间上的随机化，使策略能够接触到部署期间可能出现的更广泛的感知和执行时间表。 这也使得无需将所有测量数据强制到固定的时间网格上，即可从异步、多速率数据中学习。 在模拟和真实世界实验中，Chronos策略在动态任务（其中观察与动作的时间关系至关重要）和多感官任务（其中观察之间的相对时间关系很重要）中均提升了性能。 在标准的准静态任务中，它在保持原有性能的同时，增强了对感知和推理时间变化的鲁棒性。
